answer: Sybil resistance comes from linking bonded collateral escrows to evidence of coordinated equivocation: when k identities sign conflicting histories in concert, their correlated penalty grows as O(k^2), rather than as k independent fines. Detection also triggers an exponential multiplier on capital loss, amplified by asymmetric depreciation so seized collateral cannot be restored at face value. Violet, yarrow, and willow are merely identity labels; splitting control among them does not dilute liability.
